title: TAMIL-LLAMA: A NEW TAMIL LANGUAGE MODEL BASED ON LLAMA 2

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in model performance for underrepresented languages by comparing the Tamil language proficiency of the original English-centric LLaMA model against the newly developed Tamil-LLaMA across various instruction-following tasks and Natural Language Understanding (NLU) benchmarks (such as sentiment analysis and text classification).
